    if(meterNeedle) meterNeedle.rotation.z=(r.value==='OL'?0:Math.min(Number(r.value)||0,240)/240*2.2)-1.1;
  }

  function setLive(title,detail,kind=''){
    const box=$('v6LiveState');box.className='v6-live'+(kind?' '+kind:'');box.innerHTML=`<strong>${title}</strong><span>${detail}</span>`;
  }

  function renderUI(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-v6-phase]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',state.phases[b.dataset.v6Phase]));
    $('v6Dc24').classList.toggle('on',state.dc24);$('v6Q1').classList.toggle('on',state.q1);
    $('v6Emergency').classList.toggle('danger',!state.emergencyReleased);$('v6Door').classList.toggle('danger',!state.doorClosed);$('v6Trip').classList.toggle('danger',!state.overloadOk);$('v6SafetyReset').classList.toggle('active',state.safetyReset);$('v6Start').classList.toggle('active',state.k1Command);
    ['L1','L2','L3'].forEach(p=>$('v6Line'+p).classList.toggle('on',state.phases[p]));
    const motorStatus=$('v6MotorStatus');motorStatus.className='';
    const actual=actualK1Closed();
    if(state.stuckK1&&(!state.k1Command||!safeCondition())){motorStatus.textContent='RISCO: K1 COLADO';motorStatus.classList.add('fault');}
    else if(motorPowered()){motorStatus.textContent='MOTOR EM OPERAÇÃO';motorStatus.classList.add('run');}
    else if(actual&&state.q1&&!allPhases()){motorStatus.textContent='FALTA DE FASE';motorStatus.classList.add('fault');}
    else motorStatus.textContent='MOTOR PARADO';
    const chip=$('v6StateChip');chip.className='v6-state-chip';
    if(!state.q1&&!state.dc24&&!Object.values(state.phases).some(Boolean)){chip.textContent='DESENERGIZADA';}
    else if(!safeCondition()||state.stuckK1||state.coilOpen){chip.textContent='CONDIÇÃO DE FALHA';chip.classList.add('fault');}
    else if(motorPowered()){chip.textContent='MOTOR EM OPERAÇÃO';chip.classList.add('run');}
    else {chip.textContent=state.safetyReset?'ENERGIZADA • PRONTA':'ENERGIZADA • RESET';chip.classList.add('ready');}

    if(!state.dc24) setLive('Comando sem 24 Vcc','Ligue a fonte de comando para alimentar SR1 e a bobina de K1.');
    else if(!safeCondition()){
      const causes=[];if(!state.emergencyReleased)causes.push('emergência acionada');if(!state.doorClosed)causes.push('porta aberta');if(!state.overloadOk)causes.push('F1 desarmado');setLive('Parada segura',`Causa: ${causes.join(', ')}. Corrija a condição e execute RESET.`, 'fault');
    } else if(state.coilOpen) setLive('Falha na bobina K1','Há comando disponível, mas K1 não consegue fechar. Meça A1-A2 e compare com os contatos de potência.','fault');
    else if(state.stuckK1) setLive('Falha crítica: K1 colado','Os contatos de potência permanecem fechados mesmo sem comando de bobina. Abra Q1 para remover energia.','fault');
    else if(!state.safetyReset) setLive('Reset de segurança necessário','Permissivos OK. Pressione RESET SEG. antes de START.');
    else if(motorPowered()) setLive('Motor em operação','Três fases presentes e K1 fechado. Monitore tensões em T1/T2/T3 e U1/V1/W1.','good');
    else if(state.k1Command&&!allPhases()) setLive('Comando ativo com falta de fase','K1 foi comandado, mas nem todas as fases estão presentes. Investigue a alimentação.','fault');
    else setLive('Pronta para partida','Saída segura rearmada. Pressione START para comandar K1.');

    renderMeter();update3DVisuals();
  }

  function selectProbe(which){state.probeActive=which;renderMeter();}
  function selectTerminal(node){state.probes[state.probeActive]=node;state.probeActive=state.probeActive==='red'?'black':'red';renderMeter();highlightTerminals();}
  function highlightTerminals(){
    if(!THREE) return;
    terminalObjects.forEach(o=>{
      const n=o.userData.node;
      if(state.probes.red===n)o.material.color.set(0xe43d4f);
      else if(state.probes.black===n)o.material.color.set(0x111111);
      else o.material.color.set(o.userData.baseColor||0xb7c1c8);
    });
  }

  function resetState(){
    state.phases={L1:false,L2:false,L3:false};state.dc24=false;state.q1=false;state.emergencyReleased=true;state.doorClosed=true;state.overloadOk=true;state.safetyReset=false;state.k1Command=false;state.stuckK1=false;state.coilOpen=false;state.fault=null;state.probes={red:null,black:null};state.probeActive='red';
    $('v6FaultPrompt').innerHTML='Nenhum defeito oculto ativo. Clique em <strong>Injetar defeito</strong>.';$('v6DiagnosisResult').hidden=true;renderUI();
  }

  function newFault(){
    resetState();
    // Create a reasonable commissioning baseline, then inject one hidden defect.
    state.phases={L1:true,L2:true,L3:true};state.dc24=true;state.q1=true;state.safetyReset=true;state.k1Command=true;
    const f=faults[Math.floor(Math.random()*faults.length)];state.fault=f;f.apply();
    $('v6FaultPrompt').innerHTML='Existe <strong>1 defeito oculto</strong>. Use o multímetro, observe os estados e localize a causa sem abrir o diagnóstico.';$('v6DiagnosisResult').hidden=true;renderUI();
  }

  function revealFault(){
    const box=$('v6DiagnosisResult');box.hidden=false;
    if(!state.fault){box.innerHTML='<strong>Sem defeito oculto</strong><br>Use “Injetar defeito” para iniciar um cenário.';return;}
    box.innerHTML=`<strong>${state.fault.label}</strong><br>${state.fault.hint}`;
  }
  function hintFault(){
    const box=$('v6DiagnosisResult');box.hidden=false;box.innerHTML=state.fault?`<strong>Pista:</strong> ${state.fault.hint}`:'Injete um defeito primeiro.';
  }

  function bindControls(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-v6-phase]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const p=b.dataset.v6Phase;state.phases[p]=!state.phases[p];renderUI();}));
    $('v6Dc24').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.dc24=!state.dc24;if(!state.dc24){state.safetyReset=false;state.k1Command=false;}renderUI();});
    $('v6Q1').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.q1=!state.q1;renderUI();});
    $('v6SafetyReset').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!state.dc24){setLive('Reset bloqueado','A fonte 24 Vcc está desligada.','fault');return;}if(!safeCondition()){setLive('Reset bloqueado','Há um permissivo de segurança aberto.','fault');return;}state.safetyReset=true;renderUI();});
    $('v6Start').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!outputSafe()){setLive('Partida bloqueada','Execute o reset de segurança e confirme os permissivos.','fault');return;}if(state.coilOpen){setLive('K1 não responde','A bobina está aberta no cenário de falha.','fault');return;}state.k1Command=true;renderUI();});
    $('v6Stop').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.k1Command=false;renderUI();});
    $('v6Emergency').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.emergencyReleased=!state.emergencyReleased;state.safetyReset=false;state.k1Command=false;renderUI();});
    $('v6Door').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.doorClosed=!state.doorClosed;state.safetyReset=false;state.k1Command=false;renderUI();});
    $('v6Trip').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.overloadOk=!state.overloadOk;state.safetyReset=false;state.k1Command=false;renderUI();});
    $('v6MeterMode').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.meterMode=e.target.value;renderMeter();});
    $('v6ProbeRed').addEventListener('click',()=>selectProbe('red'));$('v6ProbeBlack').addEventListener('click',()=>selectProbe('black'));
    $('v6NewFault').addEventListener('click',newFault);$('v6Reset').addEventListener('click',resetState);$('v6RevealFault').addEventListener('click',revealFault);$('v6DiagnosisHint').addEventListener('click',hintFault);
    $('v6HomeCamera').addEventListener('click',()=>setCameraHome());$('v6FocusMotor').addEventListener('click',()=>focusMotor());
  }
  async function initThree(){
    try{
      THREE=await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/+esm');
      const controlsMod=await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.180.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js/+esm');
      const OrbitControls=controlsMod.OrbitControls;
      buildScene(OrbitControls);
      state.threeReady=true;
    }catch(err){
      console.error('V6 Three.js:',err);
      root.innerHTML='<div class="v6-loading"><strong>O ambiente 3D não pôde ser carregado.</strong><span>Verifique a conexão com a internet. Os controles, multímetro e lógica de diagnóstico continuam disponíveis.</span></div>';
    }
  }

  function makeMat(color,metalness=.15,roughness=.55){return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,metalness,roughness});}
  function addBox(group,size,pos,color,metal=.1,rough=.55){const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(...size),makeMat(color,metal,rough));m.position.set(...pos);m.castShadow=true;m.receiveShadow=true;group.add(m);return m;}
  function addCylinder(group,r,h,pos,color,rot=[Math.PI/2,0,0],metal=.2){const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r,h,32),makeMat(color,metal,.42));m.position.set(...pos);m.rotation.set(...rot);m.castShadow=true;group.add(m);return m;}
  function labelTexture(text,bg='#111820',fg='#eaf5fb'){
    const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=384;c.height=112;const x=c.getContext('2d');x.fillStyle=bg;x.fillRect(0,0,c.width,c.height);x.fillStyle=fg;x.font='700 38px Arial';x.textAlign='center';x.textBaseline='middle';x.fillText(text,c.width/2,c.height/2);const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;return t;
  }
  function addLabel(group,text,pos,size=[2.4,.7]){const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(...size),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:labelTexture(text),transparent:false}));m.position.set(...pos);group.add(m);return m;}
  function terminal(group,node,pos,baseColor=0xb8c3ca){
    const screw=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.12,.12,.09,20),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:baseColor,metalness:.9,roughness:.22}));
    screw.position.set(...pos);screw.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;screw.userData={terminal:true,node,baseColor};screw.castShadow=true;group.add(screw);terminalObjects.push(screw);
    const ring=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.14,.025,8,24),makeMat(0x111820,.25,.5));ring.position.set(pos[0],pos[1],pos[2]-.035);ring.userData={terminal:true,node,baseColor};group.add(ring);terminalObjects.push(ring);
  }
  function componentGroup(name,title,pos){const g=new THREE.Group();g.position.set(...pos);g.userData={component:true,name};scene.add(g);componentObjects.push(g);addLabel(g,title,[0,1.52,.56],[2.55,.48]);return g;}

  function buildScene(OrbitControls){
    root.innerHTML='';scene=new THREE.Scene();scene.background=new THREE.Color(0x070b0f);scene.fog=new THREE.Fog(0x070b0f,20,38);
    camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(44,root.clientWidth/Math.max(root.clientHeight,420),.1,100);camera.position.set(0,5.8,18);
    renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true,powerPreference:'high-performance'});renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));renderer.setSize(root.clientWidth,root.clientHeight||590,false);renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;renderer.outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;renderer.toneMapping=THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;renderer.toneMappingExposure=1.12;root.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
    controls=new OrbitControls(camera,renderer.domElement);controls.enableDamping=true;controls.dampingFactor=.07;controls.target.set(0,.2,0);controls.minDistance=8;controls.maxDistance=28;controls.maxPolarAngle=Math.PI*.72;
    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xbadfff,0x17202a,2.0));const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,3.2);key.position.set(5,9,8);key.castShadow=true;key.shadow.mapSize.set(2048,2048);scene.add(key);const fill=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x71cfff,1.4);fill.position.set(-9,4,6);scene.add(fill);

    // Steel backplate and DIN rails.
    const back=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(18,9,.45),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x343d45,metalness:.72,roughness:.34}));back.position.set(0,.2,-.55);back.receiveShadow=true;scene.add(back);
    [-1.6,2.25].forEach(y=>{const rail=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(16.8,.32,.34),makeMat(0xc4cbd0,.88,.24));rail.position.set(0,y,-.18);scene.add(rail);});
    // Cable ducting.
    [-7.8,7.8].forEach(x=>{const duct=addBox(scene,[.65,8,.5],[x,.2,-.05],0x161d23,.25,.6);});

    buildPowerSource();buildQ1();buildK1();buildF1();buildMotor();buildPS();buildSR1();buildEstop();buildGuard();buildMeter3D();buildPowerWires();

    raycasterHolder.raycaster=new THREE.Raycaster();raycasterHolder.pointer=new THREE.Vector2();renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown',onScenePointer);
    const resize=()=>{const w=root.clientWidth,h=root.clientHeight||590;camera.aspect=w/h;camera.updateProjectionMatrix();renderer.setSize(w,h,false);};new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(root);
    setCameraHome();animate();renderUI();
  }

  function buildPowerSource(){const g=componentGroup('REDE','REDE 3~',[-6.5,2.25,.1]);addBox(g,[2.25,2.15,1],[0,0,.1],0x18222b,.35,.42);['L1','L2','L3'].forEach((p,i)=>{const x=-.7+i*.7;terminal(g,'rede.'+p,[x,-.42,.67],[0xef4444,0xf5c842,0x3b82f6][i]);addCylinder(g,.22,.25,[x,.35,.64],[0xef4444,0xf5c842,0x3b82f6][i]);});}
  function buildQ1(){const g=componentGroup('Q1','Q1 • DISJUNTOR',[-3.4,2.25,.1]);addBox(g,[2.4,2.7,1.05],[0,0,.1],0xd4d8db,.15,.4);addBox(g,[1.45,.65,.18],[0,.28,.72],0x1b2024,.2,.42);addBox(g,[.6,.95,.22],[-.42,-.2,.74],0xc92b35,.05,.48);addBox(g,[.6,.95,.22],[.42,-.2,.74],0x161a1e,.05,.48);['1L1','3L2','5L3'].forEach((n,i)=>terminal(g,'q1.'+n,[-.72+i*.72,.95,.68]));['2T1','4T2','6T3'].forEach((n,i)=>terminal(g,'q1.'+n,[-.72+i*.72,-1.05,.68]));}
  function buildK1(){const g=componentGroup('K1','K1 • CONTATOR',[-.25,2.25,.1]);addBox(g,[2.5,2.65,1.05],[0,0,.1],0x20262b,.28,.48);addBox(g,[1.15,.8,.25],[0,.02,.75],0x1769a0,.08,.42);['L1','L2','L3'].forEach((n,i)=>terminal(g,'k1.'+n,[-.72+i*.72,.98,.68]));['T1','T2','T3'].forEach((n,i)=>terminal(g,'k1.'+n,[-.72+i*.72,-1.02,.68]));terminal(g,'k1.A1',[-1.02,.25,.68]);terminal(g,'k1.A2',[1.02,.25,.68]);terminal(g,'k1.13',[-.32,-.42,.69]);terminal(g,'k1.14',[.32,-.42,.69]);}
  function buildF1(){const g=componentGroup('F1','F1 • RELÉ TÉRMICO',[2.75,2.25,.1]);addBox(g,[2.45,2.55,1.02],[0,0,.1],0x30383e,.22,.49);addBox(g,[1.15,.62,.22],[0,.2,.72],0xd0d5d7,.12,.5);addCylinder(g,.28,.18,[0,.35,.82],0x29343b,[Math.PI/2,0,0]);['1L1','3L2','5L3'].forEach((n,i)=>terminal(g,'f1.'+n,[-.72+i*.72,.92,.68]));['2T1','4T2','6T3'].forEach((n,i)=>terminal(g,'f1.'+n,[-.72+i*.72,-.95,.68]));terminal(g,'f1.95',[-.38,-.3,.68]);terminal(g,'f1.96',[.38,-.3,.68]);}
  function buildMotor(){const g=componentGroup('M1','M1 • MOTOR',[6.1,2.15,.15]);const body=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.05,1.05,2.4,40),makeMat(0x4b5962,.62,.34));body.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;body.castShadow=true;g.add(body);for(let i=-4;i<=4;i++){const fin=addBox(g,[.12,2.25,1.5],[i*.22,0,0],0x56636c,.58,.38);}addCylinder(g,.24,1.2,[1.75,0,0],0xc0c6ca,[0,0,Math.PI/2],.85);motorRotor=addCylinder(g,.5,.12,[1.15,0,0],0x1c252c,[0,0,Math.PI/2],.4);['U1','V1','W1'].forEach((n,i)=>terminal(g,'m1.'+n,[-.5+i*.5,-1.2,.5]));}
  function buildPS(){const g=componentGroup('PS1','PS1 • 24 Vcc',[-5.8,-1.5,.1]);addBox(g,[2.2,2.3,1],[0,0,.1],0x1d2730,.28,.45);addBox(g,[1.4,.5,.2],[0,.3,.72],0x0e5f7f,.1,.4);terminal(g,'ps.P24',[-.45,-.75,.68],0xe43d4f);terminal(g,'ps.0V',[.45,-.75,.68],0x111111);}
  function buildSR1(){const g=componentGroup('SR1','SR1 • RELÉ SEG.',[-2.75,-1.5,.1]);addBox(g,[2.7,2.7,1.05],[0,0,.1],0xe0b91b,.12,.42);addBox(g,[2.25,.55,.18],[0,.25,.72],0x1f2428,.15,.45);['A1','A2','S11','S12','S21','S22'].forEach((n,i)=>terminal(g,'sr1.'+n,[-1.05+i*.42,1,.68]));['13','14','23','24'].forEach((n,i)=>terminal(g,'sr1.'+n,[-.72+i*.48,-1,.68]));}
  function buildEstop(){const g=componentGroup('S0','S0 • EMERGÊNCIA',[.8,-1.5,.1]);addBox(g,[2.1,2.5,.9],[0,0,.05],0xe0bd20,.15,.42);addCylinder(g,.7,.45,[0,.28,.75],0xc71f31,[Math.PI/2,0,0],.18);addCylinder(g,.35,.35,[0,.28,.95],0xe23543,[Math.PI/2,0,0],.12);terminal(g,'s0.11',[-.65,-.82,.61]);terminal(g,'s0.12',[-.2,-.82,.61]);terminal(g,'s0.21',[.2,-.82,.61]);terminal(g,'s0.22',[.65,-.82,.61]);}
  function buildGuard(){const g=componentGroup('G1','G1 • PORTA',[3.65,-1.5,.1]);addBox(g,[2.25,2.5,.9],[0,0,.05],0x252e35,.28,.48);addBox(g,[.55,1.35,.24],[-.35,.12,.62],0xe2b81c,.1,.42);addBox(g,[.25,1.1,.22],[.45,.12,.62],0xe2b81c,.1,.42);terminal(g,'g1.11',[-.65,-.82,.61]);terminal(g,'g1.12',[-.2,-.82,.61]);terminal(g,'g1.21',[.2,-.82,.61]);terminal(g,'g1.22',[.65,-.82,.61]);}
  function buildMeter3D(){const g=componentGroup('METER','MULTÍMETRO',[6.3,-1.65,.1]);addBox(g,[2.3,3.2,.8],[0,0,.15],0x1a2025,.15,.58);addBox(g,[1.55,.75,.12],[0,.75,.62],0xa4c49a,.02,.65);const dial=addCylinder(g,.55,.18,[0,-.18,.64],0x242d33,[Math.PI/2,0,0],.18);meterNeedle=addBox(g,[.05,.55,.05],[0,.08,.76],0xe43d4f,.1,.5);meterNeedle.position.y=-.18;meterNeedle.geometry.translate(0,.28,0);terminal(g,'meter.red',[-.45,-1.12,.62],0xe43d4f);terminal(g,'meter.black',[.45,-1.12,.62],0x111111);}
  function buildPowerWires(){
    const points={L1:[[-6.5,2.7,.35],[-3.4,3.2,.35],[-.25,3.2,.35],[2.75,3.15,.35],[6.1,1.1,.35]],L2:[[-6.5,2.25,.32],[-3.4,2.7,.32],[-.25,2.7,.32],[2.75,2.7,.32],[6.1,.8,.32]],L3:[[-6.5,1.8,.29],[-3.4,2.2,.29],[-.25,2.2,.29],[2.75,2.25,.29],[6.1,.5,.29]]};
    const colors={L1:0xef4444,L2:0xf5c842,L3:0x3b82f6};
    Object.entries(points).forEach(([p,arr])=>{const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(arr.map(v=>new THREE.Vector3(...v)));const mat=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:colors[p],emissive:0x000000,metalness:.15,roughness:.45});const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve,90,.045,10,false),mat);mesh.userData.phase=p;scene.add(mesh);wireMaterials[p]=mat;});
  }

  function update3DVisuals(){
    if(!THREE||!state.threeReady)return;
    Object.entries(wireMaterials).forEach(([p,m])=>{const on=state.phases[p];m.emissive.set(on?m.color.clone().multiplyScalar(.35):new THREE.Color(0x000000));m.opacity=on?1:.25;m.transparent=true;});
    if(motorRotor){if(motorPowered())motorRotor.material.emissive=new THREE.Color(0x174d32);else motorRotor.material.emissive=new THREE.Color(0x000000);}
  }

  function onScenePointer(ev){
    const rect=renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();raycasterHolder.pointer.x=((ev.clientX-rect.left)/rect.width)*2-1;raycasterHolder.pointer.y=-((ev.clientY-rect.top)/rect.height)*2+1;raycasterHolder.raycaster.setFromCamera(raycasterHolder.pointer,camera);
    const terminalHit=raycasterHolder.raycaster.intersectObjects(terminalObjects,false)[0];if(terminalHit&&terminalHit.object.userData.node&&!terminalHit.object.userData.node.startsWith('meter.')){selectTerminal(terminalHit.object.userData.node);return;}
    const hits=raycasterHolder.raycaster.intersectObjects(scene.children,true);for(const h of hits){let o=h.object;while(o){if(o.userData?.component){selectComponent(o.userData.name);return;}o=o.parent;}}
  }
  function selectComponent(name){const data=componentInfo[name]||['Componente','Selecione um ponto de teste.'];$('v6CompTitle').textContent=data[0];$('v6CompInfo').textContent=data[1];state.selectedComponent=name;}
  function setCameraHome(){if(!camera||!controls)return;camera.position.set(0,5.8,18);controls.target.set(0,.2,0);controls.update();}
  function focusMotor(){if(!camera||!controls)return;camera.position.set(8,3.8,10);controls.target.set(5.8,1.5,0);controls.update();}
  function animate(){requestAnimationFrame(animate);if(motorRotor&&motorPowered())motorRotor.rotation.x+=.12;controls?.update();renderer?.render(scene,camera);}

  bindControls();resetState();initThree();
  return {state,renderUI};
})();

</script>
<script>
const V7 = (() => {
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const root = $('v7Board');
  if (!root) return null;

  const STORAGE = 'cei-v7-project-v1';
  const BOARD_W = 1600, BOARD_H = 1000;
  const state = {
    project: {components: [], wires: [], nextId: 1},
    tool: 'select', wireColor: '#1ea7ff', pendingTerminal: null,
    selectedComponent: null, selectedWire: null,
    meter: {mode: 'vac', activeProbe: 'red', red: null, black: null, clampComponent: null},
    running: true, history: [], faultScenario: null,
    math: null, mathReady: false,
    solution: {dc:null, ac:null, stats:{nodes:0,elements:0,iterations:0,maxCurrent:0}, diagnostics:[], currents:{}, terminal:{}, short:false},
    thermalTimer: null, lastTick: performance.now(), protectionEvent:null,
  };

  const palette = [
    ['source3','3~','Rede 3~','Fonte 220 V'],['source24','24','Fonte 24 Vcc','Comando'],['breaker3','Q','Disjuntor motor','3 polos + aux'],
    ['contactor','K','Contator','3P + bobina + aux'],['overload','F','Relé térmico','3P + 95/96'],['motor6','M','Motor 6 pontas','3 enrolamentos'],
    ['pbNO','NA','Botoeira NA','START / RESET'],['pbNC','NF','Botoeira NF','STOP'],['emergency','EM','Emergência 2CH','2 contatos NF'],
    ['safetyRelay','SR','Relé segurança','2 canais + EDM'],['lamp','H','Sinaleiro','24 V'],['resistor','R','Resistor','Carga genérica'],['fuse','FU','Fusível','Proteção série']
  ];

  const DEF = {
    source3:{name:'Rede trifásica',kind:'source3',w:180,h:120,terms:[['L1',18,42,'left'],['L2',18,64,'left'],['L3',18,86,'left'],['N',162,64,'right']],symbol:'3~',sub:'127/220 V • 60 Hz'},
    source24:{name:'Fonte 24 Vcc',kind:'source24',w:170,h:110,terms:[['P24',20,50,'left'],['0V',150,50,'right']],symbol:'24V',sub:'Fonte de comando'},
    breaker3:{name:'Disjuntor motor',kind:'breaker3',w:190,h:145,terms:[['1L1',30,16,'top'],['3L2',95,16,'top'],['5L3',160,16,'top'],['2T1',30,129,'bottom'],['4T2',95,129,'bottom'],['6T3',160,129,'bottom'],['95',16,75,'left'],['96',174,75,'right']],symbol:'Q',sub:'Proteção + seccionamento'},
    contactor:{name:'Contator',kind:'contactor',w:200,h:165,terms:[['L1',35,16,'top'],['L2',100,16,'top'],['L3',165,16,'top'],['T1',35,149,'bottom'],['T2',100,149,'bottom'],['T3',165,149,'bottom'],['A1',16,55,'left'],['A2',184,55,'right'],['13',16,103,'left'],['14',184,103,'right'],['21',16,128,'left'],['22',184,128,'right']],symbol:'KM',sub:'3P • A1/A2 • 13/14 • 21/22'},
    overload:{name:'Relé térmico',kind:'overload',w:190,h:145,terms:[['1L1',30,16,'top'],['3L2',95,16,'top'],['5L3',160,16,'top'],['2T1',30,129,'bottom'],['4T2',95,129,'bottom'],['6T3',160,129,'bottom'],['95',16,75,'left'],['96',174,75,'right'],['97',16,103,'left'],['98',174,103,'right']],symbol:'F1',sub:'Sobrecarga • 95/96'},
    motor6:{name:'Motor trifásico 6 pontas',kind:'motor6',w:210,h:175,terms:[['U1',35,18,'top'],['V1',105,18,'top'],['W1',175,18,'top'],['U2',35,157,'bottom'],['V2',105,157,'bottom'],['W2',175,157,'bottom']],symbol:'M3~',sub:'U1/V1/W1 • U2/V2/W2'},
    pbNO:{name:'Botoeira NA',kind:'pbNO',w:150,h:105,terms:[['13',18,58,'left'],['14',132,58,'right']],symbol:'NA',sub:'Pressão momentânea'},
    pbNC:{name:'Botoeira NF',kind:'pbNC',w:150,h:105,terms:[['11',18,58,'left'],['12',132,58,'right']],symbol:'NF',sub:'Pressão momentânea'},
    emergency:{name:'Emergência 2 canais',kind:'emergency',w:180,h:135,terms:[['11',18,46,'left'],['12',162,46,'right'],['21',18,93,'left'],['22',162,93,'right']],symbol:'STOP',sub:'Cogumelo • 2 x NF'},
    safetyRelay:{name:'Relé de segurança',kind:'safetyRelay',w:225,h:195,terms:[['A1',28,17,'top'],['A2',68,17,'top'],['S11',108,17,'top'],['S12',148,17,'top'],['S21',188,17,'top'],['S22',208,52,'right'],['Y1',208,86,'right'],['Y2',208,118,'right'],['13',32,178,'bottom'],['14',72,178,'bottom'],['23',112,178,'bottom'],['24',152,178,'bottom'],['41',18,145,'left'],['42',18,112,'left']],symbol:'SR',sub:'2 canais • reset • saídas seguras'},
    lamp:{name:'Sinaleiro',kind:'lamp',w:145,h:105,terms:[['A1',18,58,'left'],['A2',127,58,'right']],symbol:'●',sub:'Indicador 24 V'},
    resistor:{name:'Resistor',kind:'resistor',w:145,h:100,terms:[['1',18,55,'left'],['2',127,55,'right']],symbol:'R',sub:'Carga linear'},
    fuse:{name:'Fusível',kind:'fuse',w:145,h:100,terms:[['1',18,55,'left'],['2',127,55,'right']],symbol:'FU',sub:'Elemento série'}
  };

  function defaultState(type,label){
    const s={label:label||DEF[type].name};
    if(type==='source3'||type==='source24') s.enabled=true;
    if(type==='breaker3') Object.assign(s,{closed:true,tripped:false});
    if(type==='contactor') Object.assign(s,{coil:false,stuck:false,coilOpen:false});
    if(type==='overload') Object.assign(s,{tripped:false,setting:12.5,thermal:0});
    if(type==='motor6') Object.assign(s,{R:25,X:17,running:false});
    if(type==='pbNO'||type==='pbNC') Object.assign(s,{pressed:false});
    if(type==='emergency') Object.assign(s,{pressed:false});
    if(type==='safetyRelay') Object.assign(s,{latched:false});
    if(type==='lamp') Object.assign(s,{on:false});
    if(type==='resistor') Object.assign(s,{R:100});
    if(type==='fuse') Object.assign(s,{blown:false});
    return s;
  }

  function compId(prefix){ return `${prefix}${state.project.nextId++}`; }
  function addComponent(type,x=360,y=220,label=null,id=null){
    const d=DEF[type]; if(!d) return null;
    const c={id:id||compId(type[0].toUpperCase()),type,x:clamp(x,0,BOARD_W-d.w),y:clamp(y,0,BOARD_H-d.h),state:defaultState(type,label)};
    state.project.components.push(c); pushHistory(); render(); return c;
  }
  const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
  const termKey=(cid,t)=>`${cid}.${t}`;
  function findComp(id){return state.project.components.find(c=>c.id===id)||null;}
  function parseTerm(key){const i=key.indexOf('.');return {cid:key.slice(0,i),term:key.slice(i+1)};}
  function hasTerm(key){const {cid,term}=parseTerm(key),c=findComp(cid);return !!(c&&DEF[c.type].terms.some(t=>t[0]===term));}

  function renderPalette(){
    $('v7Palette').innerHTML=palette.map(([type,ico,name,sub])=>`<button class="v7-palette-btn" type="button" data-add="${type}"><i>${ico}</i><span><strong>${name}</strong><small>${sub}</small></span></button>`).join('');
    $('v7Palette').querySelectorAll('[data-add]').forEach((b,i)=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const n=state.project.components.length; addComponent(b.dataset.add,290+(n%4)*200,100+Math.floor(n/4)*175);
    }));
  }

  function componentClass(c){
    let cls=`v7-component ${c.type}`;
    if(state.selectedComponent===c.id)cls+=' selected';
    if(c.type==='contactor'&&c.state.coil)cls+=' state-on';
    if(c.type==='lamp'&&c.state.on)cls+=' state-on';
    if((c.type==='breaker3'&&c.state.tripped)||(c.type==='overload'&&c.state.tripped)||(c.type==='emergency'&&c.state.pressed))cls+=' state-fault';
    return cls;
  }
  function compStatus(c){
    switch(c.type){
      case 'source3':case 'source24': return c.state.enabled?'ON':'OFF';
      case 'breaker3': return c.state.tripped?'TRIP':(c.state.closed?'ON':'OFF');
      case 'contactor': return c.state.stuck?'COLADO':(c.state.coil?'ENERG.':'ABERTO');
      case 'overload': return c.state.tripped?'TRIP':`${Number(c.state.setting).toFixed(1)} A`;
      case 'motor6': return c.state.running?'GIRANDO':'PARADO';
      case 'pbNO':case 'pbNC': return c.state.pressed?'PRESSIONADO':'REPOUSO';
      case 'emergency': return c.state.pressed?'ACIONADA':'LIBERADA';
      case 'safetyRelay': return c.state.latched?'READY':'SAFE';
      case 'lamp': return c.state.on?'ACESO':'APAGADO';
      case 'resistor': return `${c.state.R} Ω`;
      case 'fuse': return c.state.blown?'ABERTO':'OK';
      default:return '';
    }
  }
  function renderComponents(){
    const host=$('v7Components');
    host.innerHTML=state.project.components.map(c=>{
      const d=DEF[c.type];
      return `<article class="${componentClass(c)}" data-cid="${c.id}" style="left:${c.x}px;top:${c.y}px;width:${d.w}px;height:${d.h}px">
        <div class="v7-comp-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(c.state.label)}</strong><span>${compStatus(c)}</span></div>
        <div class="v7-comp-body"><div><div class="v7-comp-symbol">${d.symbol}</div><small>${d.sub}</small></div></div>
        ${d.terms.map(([t,x,y,side])=>`<button type="button" class="v7-terminal ${side}" data-terminal="${c.id}.${t}" data-label="${t}" style="left:${x}px;top:${y}px" aria-label="${c.state.label} borne ${t}"></button>`).join('')}
      </article>`;
    }).join('');
    $('v7EmptyHint').hidden=state.project.components.length>0;
    host.querySelectorAll('.v7-component').forEach(el=>bindComponentElement(el));
    host.querySelectorAll('.v7-terminal').forEach(el=>{
      el.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();handleTerminalClick(el.dataset.terminal);});
      el.addEventListener('pointerenter',()=>{if(state.pendingTerminal&&state.tool==='wire') drawWirePreview(state.pendingTerminal,el.dataset.terminal);});
      el.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{if(state.pendingTerminal) clearWirePreview();});
    });
    applyElectricalClasses();
  }

  function bindComponentElement(el){
    const id=el.dataset.cid, head=el.querySelector('.v7-comp-head');
    el.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.closest('.v7-terminal'))return;selectComponent(id);});
    head.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
      if(e.button!==0)return; e.preventDefault(); selectComponent(id);
      const c=findComp(id), rect=root.getBoundingClientRect();
      const start={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,cx:c.x,cy:c.y};
      try{head.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch{}
      const move=(ev)=>{c.x=clamp(start.cx+ev.clientX-start.x,0,BOARD_W-DEF[c.type].w);c.y=clamp(start.cy+ev.clientY-start.y,0,BOARD_H-DEF[c.type].h);el.style.left=c.x+'px';el.style.top=c.y+'px';drawWires();};
      const up=(ev)=>{try{head.releasePointerCapture(ev.pointerId);}catch{}head.removeEventListener('pointermove',move);head.removeEventListener('pointerup',up);saveProject();};
      head.addEventListener('pointermove',move);head.addEventListener('pointerup',up);
    });
  }

  function terminalCenter(key){
    const btn=$('v7Components').querySelector(`[data-terminal="${cssEscape(key)}"]`); if(!btn)return null;
    const br=btn.getBoundingClientRect(), rr=root.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {x:br.left+br.width/2-rr.left+root.scrollLeft,y:br.top+br.height/2-rr.top+root.scrollTop};
  }
  const cssEscape=s=>window.CSS&&CSS.escape?CSS.escape(s):s.replace(/([.#:[\],=])/g,'\\$1');
  function bezier(a,b){const dx=Math.max(45,Math.abs(b.x-a.x)*.45);return `M ${a.x} ${a.y} C ${a.x+Math.sign(b.x-a.x||1)*dx} ${a.y}, ${b.x-Math.sign(b.x-a.x||1)*dx} ${b.y}, ${b.x} ${b.y}`;}
  function drawWires(){
    const layer=$('v7WireLayer');
    layer.innerHTML=state.project.wires.map(w=>{const a=terminalCenter(w.a),b=terminalCenter(w.b);if(!a||!b)return'';const cls=['v7-wire'];if(state.selectedWire===w.id)cls.push('selected');const ws=wireElectricalState(w);if(ws.energized)cls.push('energized');if(ws.fault)cls.push('fault');return `<path data-wire="${w.id}" class="${cls.join(' ')}" d="${bezier(a,b)}" stroke="${ws.color||w.color}" style="color:${ws.color||w.color}"><title>${escapeHtml(labelTerm(w.a))} ↔ ${escapeHtml(labelTerm(w.b))}</title></path>`;}).join('');
    layer.querySelectorAll('[data-wire]').forEach(p=>p.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();state.selectedWire=p.dataset.wire;state.selectedComponent=null;renderInspector();drawWires();}));
  }
  function drawWirePreview(aKey,bKey){const a=terminalCenter(aKey),b=terminalCenter(bKey);if(!a||!b)return;const p=$('v7WirePreview');p.hidden=false;p.setAttribute('d',bezier(a,b));}
  function clearWirePreview(){const p=$('v7WirePreview');p.hidden=true;p.setAttribute('d','');}
  function labelTerm(key){const {cid,term}=parseTerm(key),c=findComp(cid);return c?`${c.state.label} ${term}`:key;}

  function handleTerminalClick(key){
    if(state.tool==='meter'){assignProbe(key);return;}
    if(state.tool!=='wire'){selectComponent(parseTerm(key).cid);return;}
    if(!state.pendingTerminal){state.pendingTerminal=key;markPending();return;}
    if(state.pendingTerminal===key){state.pendingTerminal=null;markPending();return;}
    if(state.project.wires.some(w=>(w.a===state.pendingTerminal&&w.b===key)||(w.a===key&&w.b===state.pendingTerminal))){toast('Esses bornes já estão ligados.');state.pendingTerminal=null;markPending();return;}
    state.project.wires.push({id:'W'+state.project.nextId++,a:state.pendingTerminal,b:key,color:state.wireColor});
    state.pendingTerminal=null;pushHistory();render();
  }
  function markPending(){document.querySelectorAll('.v7-terminal').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('pending',b.dataset.terminal===state.pendingTerminal));if(!state.pendingTerminal)clearWirePreview();}

  function selectComponent(id){state.selectedComponent=id;state.selectedWire=null;renderComponents();renderInspector();drawWires();}
  function setTool(tool){state.tool=tool;state.pendingTerminal=null;clearWirePreview();document.querySelectorAll('[data-v7-tool]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.v7Tool===tool));markPending();if(tool==='meter')$('v7MeterHint').innerHTML='Clique em dois bornes para posicionar as pontas do multímetro.';}

  // ---------- Complex arithmetic + MNA ----------
  const C=(re=0,im=0)=>({re:Number(re)||0,im:Number(im)||0});
  const cadd=(a,b)=>C(a.re+b.re,a.im+b.im), csub=(a,b)=>C(a.re-b.re,a.im-b.im), cmul=(a,b)=>C(a.re*b.re-a.im*b.im,a.re*b.im+a.im*b.re);
  const cdiv=(a,b)=>{const d=b.re*b.re+b.im*b.im||1e-30;return C((a.re*b.re+a.im*b.im)/d,(a.im*b.re-a.re*b.im)/d)};
  const cabs=a=>Math.hypot(a.re,a.im), cneg=a=>C(-a.re,-a.im), cscale=(a,s)=>C(a.re*s,a.im*s);
  const cInv=a=>cdiv(C(1,0),a);
  const polar=(mag,deg)=>C(mag*Math.cos(deg*Math.PI/180),mag*Math.sin(deg*Math.PI/180));
  const zero=()=>C(0,0);

  class UF{constructor(){this.p=new Map()} find(x){if(!this.p.has(x))this.p.set(x,x);let p=this.p.get(x);if(p!==x){p=this.find(p);this.p.set(x,p)}return p} union(a,b){a=this.find(a);b=this.find(b);if(a!==b)this.p.set(b,a)}}

  function wireUF(){const uf=new UF();state.project.components.forEach(c=>DEF[c.type].terms.forEach(t=>uf.find(termKey(c.id,t[0]))));state.project.wires.forEach(w=>{if(hasTerm(w.a)&&hasTerm(w.b))uf.union(w.a,w.b)});return uf;}

  function closedLinks(excludeSafetyOutputs=false){
    const links=[];
    for(const c of state.project.components){
      const t=(a,b)=>links.push([termKey(c.id,a),termKey(c.id,b),c]);
      switch(c.type){
        case 'breaker3': if(c.state.closed&&!c.state.tripped){t('1L1','2T1');t('3L2','4T2');t('5L3','6T3');} if(!c.state.tripped)t('95','96'); break;
        case 'contactor': {const on=c.state.stuck||c.state.coil;if(on){t('L1','T1');t('L2','T2');t('L3','T3');t('13','14');}else t('21','22');break;}
        case 'overload': if(!c.state.tripped){t('1L1','2T1');t('3L2','4T2');t('5L3','6T3');t('95','96');}else t('97','98');break;
        case 'pbNO': if(c.state.pressed)t('13','14');break;
        case 'pbNC': if(!c.state.pressed)t('11','12');break;
        case 'emergency': if(!c.state.pressed){t('11','12');t('21','22');}break;
        case 'safetyRelay': if(!excludeSafetyOutputs){if(c.state.latched){t('13','14');t('23','24');}else t('41','42');}break;
        case 'fuse': if(!c.state.blown)t('1','2');break;
      }
    }
    return links;
  }

  function connectivityGraph(excludeSafetyOutputs=false){
    const g=new Map(), add=(a,b)=>{if(!g.has(a))g.set(a,new Set());if(!g.has(b))g.set(b,new Set());g.get(a).add(b);g.get(b).add(a)};
    state.project.wires.forEach(w=>add(w.a,w.b));closedLinks(excludeSafetyOutputs).forEach(([a,b])=>add(a,b));return g;
  }
  function hasPath(a,b,excludeSafetyOutputs=false){
    if(a===b)return true;const g=connectivityGraph(excludeSafetyOutputs),q=[a],seen=new Set([a]);while(q.length){const n=q.shift();for(const x of g.get(n)||[]){if(x===b)return true;if(!seen.has(x)){seen.add(x);q.push(x)}}}return false;
  }

  function elements(domain, options={}){
    const es=[], addR=(a,b,z,name,owner)=>es.push({type:'R',a,b,z,domain,name,owner}), addV=(a,b,v,name,owner)=>es.push({type:'V',a,b,v,domain,name,owner});
    for(const c of state.project.components){
      const k=t=>termKey(c.id,t), s=c.state;
      switch(c.type){
        case 'source3': if(domain==='ac'&&s.enabled&&!options.disableSources){[['L1',0],['L2',-120],['L3',120]].forEach(([p,ang])=>{const inn=`${c.id}.__${p}`;addV(inn,k('N'),polar(127,ang),`${c.id}.${p}.V`,c.id);addR(inn,k(p),C(.08,.02),`${c.id}.${p}.Zs`,c.id)});} else if(domain==='ac'&&s.enabled&&options.disableSources){['L1','L2','L3'].forEach(p=>addR(k(p),k('N'),C(.08,.02),`${c.id}.${p}.off`,c.id));} break;
        case 'source24': if(domain==='dc'&&s.enabled&&!options.disableSources){const inn=`${c.id}.__P`;addV(inn,k('0V'),C(24,0),`${c.id}.V24`,c.id);addR(inn,k('P24'),C(.08,0),`${c.id}.Zs`,c.id);} else if(domain==='dc'&&s.enabled&&options.disableSources)addR(k('P24'),k('0V'),C(.08,0),`${c.id}.off`,c.id);break;
        case 'breaker3': if(domain==='ac'&&s.closed&&!s.tripped){[['1L1','2T1'],['3L2','4T2'],['5L3','6T3']].forEach((p,i)=>addR(k(p[0]),k(p[1]),C(.003,.0003),`${c.id}.P${i+1}`,c.id));} if(domain==='dc'&&!s.tripped)addR(k('95'),k('96'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.95-96`,c.id);break;
        case 'contactor': if(domain==='dc'){if(!s.coilOpen)addR(k('A1'),k('A2'),C(240,0),`${c.id}.coil`,c.id);const on=s.stuck||s.coil;if(on)addR(k('13'),k('14'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.13-14`,c.id);else addR(k('21'),k('22'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.21-22`,c.id);} if(domain==='ac'&&(s.stuck||s.coil)){[['L1','T1'],['L2','T2'],['L3','T3']].forEach((p,i)=>addR(k(p[0]),k(p[1]),C(.004,.0003),`${c.id}.P${i+1}`,c.id));}break;
        case 'overload': if(domain==='ac'&&!s.tripped){[['1L1','2T1'],['3L2','4T2'],['5L3','6T3']].forEach((p,i)=>addR(k(p[0]),k(p[1]),C(.006,.0005),`${c.id}.P${i+1}`,c.id));} if(domain==='dc'){if(!s.tripped)addR(k('95'),k('96'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.95-96`,c.id);else addR(k('97'),k('98'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.97-98`,c.id);}break;
        case 'motor6': if(domain==='ac'){const z=C(Number(s.R)||7,Number(s.X)||5);addR(k('U1'),k('U2'),z,`${c.id}.U`,c.id);addR(k('V1'),k('V2'),z,`${c.id}.V`,c.id);addR(k('W1'),k('W2'),z,`${c.id}.W`,c.id);} else if(domain==='ohm'){const r=C(Number(s.R)||7,0);addR(k('U1'),k('U2'),r,`${c.id}.U`,c.id);addR(k('V1'),k('V2'),r,`${c.id}.V`,c.id);addR(k('W1'),k('W2'),r,`${c.id}.W`,c.id);}break;
        case 'pbNO': if(domain==='dc'&&s.pressed)addR(k('13'),k('14'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.contact`,c.id);break;
        case 'pbNC': if(domain==='dc'&&!s.pressed)addR(k('11'),k('12'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.contact`,c.id);break;
        case 'emergency': if(domain==='dc'&&!s.pressed){addR(k('11'),k('12'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.ch1`,c.id);addR(k('21'),k('22'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.ch2`,c.id);}break;
        case 'safetyRelay': if(domain==='dc'){addR(k('A1'),k('A2'),C(480,0),`${c.id}.coil`,c.id);if(s.latched){addR(k('13'),k('14'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.out1`,c.id);addR(k('23'),k('24'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.out2`,c.id);}else addR(k('41'),k('42'),C(.02,0),`${c.id}.aux`,c.id);}break;
        case 'lamp': if(domain==='dc')addR(k('A1'),k('A2'),C(600,0),`${c.id}.lamp`,c.id); if(domain==='ac')addR(k('A1'),k('A2'),C(5000,0),`${c.id}.lampAC`,c.id);break;
        case 'resistor': addR(k('1'),k('2'),C(Math.max(.01,Number(s.R)||100),0),`${c.id}.R`,c.id);break;
        case 'fuse': if(!s.blown)addR(k('1'),k('2'),C(.01,0),`${c.id}.fuse`,c.id);break;
      }
    }
    return es;
  }

  function chooseGround(domain, uf){
    const s=state.project.components.find(c=>domain==='ac'?c.type==='source3':c.type==='source24');
    if(s)return uf.find(termKey(s.id,domain==='ac'?'N':'0V'));return '__GROUND__';
  }
  function solve(domain, opts={}){
    const uf=wireUF(), es=elements(domain,opts), test=opts.testSource;
    if(test)es.push({type:'V',a:test.a,b:test.b,v:C(test.v,0),domain,name:'__TEST__',owner:'__TEST__'});
    const all=new Set();es.forEach(e=>{all.add(uf.find(e.a));all.add(uf.find(e.b))});state.project.wires.forEach(w=>{all.add(uf.find(w.a));all.add(uf.find(w.b))});
    const ground=opts.ground?uf.find(opts.ground):chooseGround(domain==='ohm'?'dc':domain,uf);all.delete(ground);
    const nodes=[...all], idx=new Map(nodes.map((n,i)=>[n,i])), vs=es.filter(e=>e.type==='V'), n=nodes.length, m=vs.length, size=n+m;
    const A=Array.from({length:size},()=>Array.from({length:size},zero)), B=Array.from({length:size},zero);
    const stampG=(a,b,y)=>{a=uf.find(a);b=uf.find(b);const ia=idx.get(a),ib=idx.get(b);if(a!==ground&&ia!==undefined)A[ia][ia]=cadd(A[ia][ia],y);if(b!==ground&&ib!==undefined)A[ib][ib]=cadd(A[ib][ib],y);if(a!==ground&&b!==ground&&ia!==undefined&&ib!==undefined){A[ia][ib]=csub(A[ia][ib],y);A[ib][ia]=csub(A[ib][ia],y)}};
    es.filter(e=>e.type==='R').forEach(e=>stampG(e.a,e.b,cInv(e.z)));
    // tiny conductance to reference for floating islands
    nodes.forEach((node,i)=>{A[i][i]=cadd(A[i][i],C(1e-10,0));});
    vs.forEach((e,j)=>{const row=n+j,a=uf.find(e.a),b=uf.find(e.b),ia=idx.get(a),ib=idx.get(b);if(a!==ground&&ia!==undefined){A[ia][row]=cadd(A[ia][row],C(1,0));A[row][ia]=cadd(A[row][ia],C(1,0));}if(b!==ground&&ib!==undefined){A[ib][row]=csub(A[ib][row],C(1,0));A[row][ib]=csub(A[row][ib],C(1,0));}B[row]=e.v;});
    let X;try{X=solveLinear(A,B);}catch(err){return {ok:false,error:err.message,nodes:n,elements:es.length,uf,ground,volt:new Map(),currents:{}}}
    const volt=new Map([[ground,C(0,0)]]);nodes.forEach((node,i)=>volt.set(node,X[i]||C(0,0)));
    const currents={};
    es.forEach(e=>{if(e.type==='R'){const va=volt.get(uf.find(e.a))||zero(),vb=volt.get(uf.find(e.b))||zero();currents[e.name]=cdiv(csub(va,vb),e.z);} });
    vs.forEach((e,j)=>currents[e.name]=X[n+j]||zero());
    return {ok:true,nodes:n,elements:es.length,uf,ground,volt,currents,elementsList:es};
  }

  function solveLinear(A,B){
    const n=A.length;if(!n)return[];
    if(state.mathReady&&state.math?.lusolve&&state.math?.complex){
      try{
        const Am=A.map(row=>row.map(z=>state.math.complex(z.re,z.im)));
        const Bm=B.map(z=>[state.math.complex(z.re,z.im)]);
        const out=state.math.lusolve(Am,Bm);
        return out.map(r=>{const z=r[0];return C(typeof z==='number'?z:z.re||0,typeof z==='number'?0:z.im||0)});
      }catch(e){console.info('V7: fallback para solver interno.',e);}
    }
    const M=A.map((row,i)=>row.map(v=>C(v.re,v.im)).concat([C(B[i].re,B[i].im)]));
    for(let k=0;k<n;k++){
      let p=k,best=cabs(M[k][k]);for(let i=k+1;i<n;i++){const a=cabs(M[i][k]);if(a>best){best=a;p=i}}
      if(best<1e-16)throw new Error('Matriz singular: verifique nós flutuantes ou fontes conflitantes.');
      if(p!==k)[M[p],M[k]]=[M[k],M[p]];
      const piv=M[k][k];for(let j=k;j<=n;j++)M[k][j]=cdiv(M[k][j],piv);
      for(let i=0;i<n;i++){if(i===k)continue;const f=M[i][k];if(cabs(f)<1e-20)continue;for(let j=k;j<=n;j++)M[i][j]=csub(M[i][j],cmul(f,M[k][j]));}
    }
    return M.map(r=>r[n]);
  }

  function voltage(sol,key){if(!sol||!sol.ok||!hasTerm(key))return C(0,0);return sol.volt.get(sol.uf.find(key))||C(0,0)}
  function vdiff(sol,a,b){return csub(voltage(sol,a),voltage(sol,b));}
  function currentOfOwner(owner,domain='ac'){const sol=domain==='ac'?state.solution.ac:state.solution.dc;if(!sol||!sol.ok)return 0;let max=0;for(const [name,i] of Object.entries(sol.currents))if(name.startsWith(owner+'.'))max=Math.max(max,cabs(i));return max;}
  function currentOfOwnerIn(sol,owner){if(!sol||!sol.ok)return 0;let max=0;for(const [name,i] of Object.entries(sol.currents))if(name.startsWith(owner+'.'))max=Math.max(max,cabs(i));return max;}

  function evaluateSafetyRelay(c,dc){
    const powered=cabs(vdiff(dc,termKey(c.id,'A1'),termKey(c.id,'A2')))>=18;
    const ch1=hasPath(termKey(c.id,'S11'),termKey(c.id,'S12'),true), ch2=hasPath(termKey(c.id,'S21'),termKey(c.id,'S22'),true), reset=hasPath(termKey(c.id,'Y1'),termKey(c.id,'Y2'),true);
    if(!powered||!ch1||!ch2)c.state.latched=false;else if(reset)c.state.latched=true;
    return {powered,ch1,ch2,reset};
  }

  function runSolver(force=false){
    if(!state.running&&!force)return;
    let iterations=0, changed=true, dc,ac;const diag=[];
    while(changed&&iterations<8){
      iterations++;changed=false;dc=solve('dc');ac=solve('ac');
      if(!dc.ok||!ac.ok)break;
      for(const c of state.project.components){
        if(c.type==='contactor'){
          const v=cabs(vdiff(dc,termKey(c.id,'A1'),termKey(c.id,'A2')));const old=c.state.coil;const next=c.state.coil?(v>8):(v>=18);if(c.state.coilOpen)c.state.coil=false;else c.state.coil=next;if(old!==c.state.coil)changed=true;
        }
        if(c.type==='safetyRelay'){const old=c.state.latched;evaluateSafetyRelay(c,dc);if(old!==c.state.latched)changed=true;}
      }
    }
    dc=solve('dc');ac=solve('ac');
    const terminal={};for(const c of state.project.components)for(const t of DEF[c.type].terms){const k=termKey(c.id,t[0]);terminal[k]={dc:voltage(dc,k),ac:voltage(ac,k)}}
    let maxCurrent=0;const currents={};[dc,ac].forEach(sol=>{if(!sol||!sol.ok)return;for(const [n,i] of Object.entries(sol.currents)){const a=cabs(i);currents[n]=a;maxCurrent=Math.max(maxCurrent,a)}});

    // dynamic states
    let motorRun=false;
    for(const c of state.project.components){
      if(c.type==='lamp'){const vdc=cabs(vdiff(dc,termKey(c.id,'A1'),termKey(c.id,'A2'))),vac=cabs(vdiff(ac,termKey(c.id,'A1'),termKey(c.id,'A2')));c.state.on=Math.max(vdc,vac)>12;}
      if(c.type==='motor6'){const iu=ac&&ac.ok?cabs(ac.currents[`${c.id}.U`]||zero()):0,iv=ac&&ac.ok?cabs(ac.currents[`${c.id}.V`]||zero()):0,iw=ac&&ac.ok?cabs(ac.currents[`${c.id}.W`]||zero()):0;const avg=(iu+iv+iw)/3;c.state.running=avg>1&&Math.min(iu,iv,iw)>avg*.65;motorRun=motorRun||c.state.running;if(avg>0&&Math.min(iu,iv,iw)<avg*.35)diag.push({type:'warn',text:`${c.state.label}: forte desequilíbrio/falta de fase (${iu.toFixed(1)} / ${iv.toFixed(1)} / ${iw.toFixed(1)} A).`});}
    }

    // short + breaker trip model
    let short=false;
    for(const c of state.project.components.filter(c=>c.type==='source3'||c.type==='source24')){
      const I=currentOfOwnerIn(c.type==='source3'?ac:dc,c.id);if(I>80){short=true;diag.push({type:'fault',text:`${c.state.label}: corrente de falta elevada (${I.toFixed(0)} A). Possível curto-circuito.`});}
    }
    for(const c of state.project.components.filter(c=>c.type==='breaker3')){
      const I=currentOfOwnerIn(ac,c.id);if(I>60&&!c.state.tripped){c.state.tripped=true;c.state.closed=false;state.protectionEvent=`${c.state.label} disparou magneticamente no modelo didático (${I.toFixed(0)} A).`;diag.push({type:'fault',text:state.protectionEvent});setTimeout(()=>runSolver(true),0);}
    }

    // cross-domain wiring warning
    const mix=detectMixedDomain();if(mix)diag.push({type:'fault',text:'Interligação AC/DC detectada entre a rede de potência e a fonte 24 Vcc. Revise a fiação.'});
    if(state.protectionEvent)diag.push({type:'warn',text:'Último evento de proteção: '+state.protectionEvent});
    if(!state.project.wires.length)diag.push({type:'warn',text:'Não há fios instalados na bancada.'});
    if(dc&&!dc.ok)diag.push({type:'fault',text:'Solver DC: '+dc.error});
    if(ac&&!ac.ok)diag.push({type:'fault',text:'Solver AC: '+ac.error});
    if(!short&&!mix&&dc?.ok&&ac?.ok)diag.push({type:'good',text:'Topologia resolvida sem curto direto detectado.'});

    state.solution={dc,ac,terminal,currents,short,diagnostics:diag,stats:{nodes:Math.max(dc?.nodes||0,ac?.nodes||0),elements:(dc?.elements||0)+(ac?.elements||0),iterations,maxCurrent}};
    updateThermal();updateUI();
  }

  function detectMixedDomain(){
    const g=connectivityGraph(false), ac=[],dc=[];for(const c of state.project.components){if(c.type==='source3'&&c.state.enabled)ac.push(termKey(c.id,'L1'),termKey(c.id,'L2'),termKey(c.id,'L3'));if(c.type==='source24'&&c.state.enabled)dc.push(termKey(c.id,'P24'),termKey(c.id,'0V'));}
    for(const a of ac)for(const d of dc){if(hasGraphPath(g,a,d))return true;}return false;
  }
  function hasGraphPath(g,a,b){const q=[a],seen=new Set([a]);while(q.length){const n=q.shift();if(n===b)return true;for(const x of g.get(n)||[])if(!seen.has(x)){seen.add(x);q.push(x)}}return false;}

  function updateThermal(){
    const now=performance.now(),dt=Math.min(1,(now-state.lastTick)/1000);state.lastTick=now;
    for(const c of state.project.components.filter(c=>c.type==='overload')){
      const I=currentOfOwner(c.id,'ac'),set=Math.max(.1,Number(c.state.setting)||12.5),r=I/set;
      if(!c.state.tripped){if(r>1.15)c.state.thermal+=dt*Math.pow(r,2);else c.state.thermal=Math.max(0,c.state.thermal-dt*.4);if(r>6||c.state.thermal>8){c.state.tripped=true;state.protectionEvent=`${c.state.label}: sobrecarga detectada — contato 95/96 aberto.`;toast(state.protectionEvent);setTimeout(()=>runSolver(true),0);}}
    }
  }

  // ---------- Meter ----------
  function assignProbe(key){
    const which=state.meter.activeProbe;state.meter[which]=key;state.meter.activeProbe=which==='red'?'black':'red';renderMeter();
  }
  function equivalentResistance(a,b){
    if(!a||!b)return null;if(a===b)return 0;
    const sol=solve('ohm',{disableSources:true,testSource:{a,b,v:1},ground:b});if(!sol.ok)return Infinity;const i=cabs(sol.currents.__TEST__||zero());return i<1e-9?Infinity:1/i;
  }
  function renderMeter(){
    const m=state.meter,r=m.red,b=m.black,mode=m.mode;document.querySelectorAll('.v7-probe').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x.id===(m.activeProbe==='red'?'v7ProbeRed':'v7ProbeBlack')));
    $('v7RedLabel').textContent=r?labelTerm(r):'Ponta vermelha';$('v7BlackLabel').textContent=b?labelTerm(b):'Ponta preta';
    let val=0,unit=mode==='vac'?'V AC':mode==='vdc'?'V DC':mode==='ohm'?'Ω':'A AC',hint='Selecione dois bornes.';let beep='';
    if(mode==='clamp'){
      if(state.meter.clampComponent){val=currentOfOwner(state.meter.clampComponent,'ac');hint=`Corrente máxima de ramo em ${findComp(state.meter.clampComponent)?.state.label||''}.`;}else hint='Selecione um componente para usar o alicate virtual.';
    }else if(r&&b){
      if(mode==='vac'){val=cabs(vdiff(state.solution.ac,r,b));hint=`${labelTerm(r)} ↔ ${labelTerm(b)}`;}
      if(mode==='vdc'){const d=vdiff(state.solution.dc,r,b);val=d.re;hint=`${labelTerm(r)} ↔ ${labelTerm(b)}`;}
      if(mode==='ohm'){const R=equivalentResistance(r,b);if(!Number.isFinite(R)){val='OL';unit='';hint='Circuito aberto ou resistência muito alta.';}else{val=R;unit='Ω';if(R<30){beep='BEEP';hint='Continuidade detectada.';}else hint='Sem continuidade de baixa resistência.';}}
    }
    $('v7MeterValue').textContent=typeof val==='string'?val:(Math.abs(val)>=1000?val.toFixed(0):Math.abs(val)>=100?val.toFixed(1):val.toFixed(2));$('v7MeterUnit').textContent=unit;$('v7MeterBeep').textContent=beep;$('v7MeterHint').innerHTML=hint;
  }

  // ---------- UI ----------
  function applyElectricalClasses(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.v7-terminal').forEach(el=>{const k=el.dataset.terminal,t=state.solution.terminal[k];el.classList.remove('ac-hot','dc-hot','fault');if(!t)return;const ac=cabs(t.ac),dc=Math.abs(t.dc.re);if(ac>20)el.classList.add('ac-hot');else if(dc>5)el.classList.add('dc-hot');if(state.solution.short){} });
  }
  function wireElectricalState(w){const ta=state.solution.terminal[w.a],tb=state.solution.terminal[w.b];if(!ta||!tb)return {energized:false,color:w.color};const ac=Math.max(cabs(ta.ac),cabs(tb.ac)),dc=Math.max(Math.abs(ta.dc.re),Math.abs(tb.dc.re));if(state.solution.short&&ac>20)return {energized:true,fault:true,color:'#ff4a5f'};if(ac>20)return {energized:true,color:'#ffb348'};if(dc>5)return {energized:true,color:'#58e6b0'};return {energized:false,color:w.color};}
  function updateUI(){
    const s=state.solution.stats,diag=state.solution.diagnostics;const chip=$('v7SolverState');chip.className='v7-solver-chip';if(diag.some(d=>d.type==='fault'))chip.classList.add('fault');else if(diag.some(d=>d.type==='warn'))chip.classList.add('warn');else chip.classList.add('ready');chip.querySelector('span').textContent=diag.some(d=>d.type==='fault')?'Falha elétrica detectada':state.running?`Solver em tempo real • ${state.mathReady?'math.js LU':'MNA interno'}`:'Solver pausado';
    $('v7NodeCount').textContent=s.nodes;$('v7ElementCount').textContent=s.elements;$('v7IterationCount').textContent=s.iterations;$('v7MaxCurrent').textContent=formatA(s.maxCurrent);$('v7MotorState').textContent=state.project.components.some(c=>c.type==='motor6'&&c.state.running)?'EM OPERAÇÃO':'PARADO';
    $('v7Diagnostics').innerHTML=diag.map(d=>`<div class="v7-diag ${d.type}">${escapeHtml(d.text)}</div>`).join('')||'<p class="muted">Sem ocorrências.</p>';
    renderComponents();drawWires();renderMeter();renderInspector();
  }
  function renderInspector(){
    const title=$('v7InspectorTitle'),text=$('v7InspectorText'),actions=$('v7InspectorActions'),read=$('v7TerminalReadings');actions.innerHTML='';read.innerHTML='';
    if(state.selectedWire){const w=state.project.wires.find(x=>x.id===state.selectedWire);if(!w){state.selectedWire=null;return renderInspector()}title.textContent=`Fio ${w.id}`;text.textContent=`${labelTerm(w.a)} ↔ ${labelTerm(w.b)}`;actions.innerHTML='<button class="btn" id="v7DeleteWire" type="button">Excluir fio</button>';document.getElementById('v7DeleteWire').onclick=()=>{state.project.wires=state.project.wires.filter(x=>x.id!==w.id);state.selectedWire=null;pushHistory();render();};return;}
    const c=findComp(state.selectedComponent);if(!c){title.textContent='Nenhum componente selecionado';text.textContent='Selecione um componente para ver estado, tensões, correntes e ações.';return;}
    title.textContent=`${c.state.label} • ${DEF[c.type].name}`;text.textContent=inspectorDescription(c);
    const btns=[];
    if(c.type==='source3'||c.type==='source24')btns.push(['toggleSource',c.state.enabled?'Desligar fonte':'Ligar fonte']);
    if(c.type==='breaker3'){btns.push(['toggleBreaker',c.state.closed?'Abrir Q':'Fechar Q']);if(c.state.tripped)btns.push(['resetBreaker','Rearmar']);}
    if(c.type==='pbNO'||c.type==='pbNC')btns.push(['press','Pressionar']);
    if(c.type==='emergency')btns.push(['toggleEmergency',c.state.pressed?'Destravar emergência':'Acionar emergência']);
    if(c.type==='overload'){btns.push(['tripOverload','Simular TRIP']);if(c.state.tripped)btns.push(['resetOverload','Rearmar F1']);}
    if(c.type==='contactor')btns.push(['faultStuck',c.state.stuck?'Remover falha COLADO':'Falha: contato colado'],['faultCoil',c.state.coilOpen?'Reparar bobina':'Falha: bobina aberta']);
    if(c.type==='fuse'&&c.state.blown)btns.push(['resetFuse','Trocar fusível']);
    btns.push(['rename','Renomear'],['delete','Excluir']);
    actions.innerHTML=btns.map(([a,l])=>`<button class="btn ${a.startsWith('fault')?'btn-secondary':''}" type="button" data-inspect-action="${a}">${l}</button>`).join('');
    actions.querySelectorAll('[data-inspect-action]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>inspectorAction(c,b.dataset.inspectAction));
    read.innerHTML=DEF[c.type].terms.map(([t])=>{const k=termKey(c.id,t),vr=state.solution.terminal[k]||{ac:zero(),dc:zero()};return `<div class="v7-reading"><span>${t}</span><b>${cabs(vr.ac).toFixed(1)} V~</b><em>${vr.dc.re.toFixed(1)} V⎓</em></div>`;}).join('')+`<div class="v7-reading"><span>Corrente máx.</span><b>${formatA(Math.max(currentOfOwner(c.id,'ac'),currentOfOwner(c.id,'dc')))}</b><em>${compStatus(c)}</em></div>`;
    if(state.meter.mode==='clamp')state.meter.clampComponent=c.id;
  }
  function inspectorDescription(c){
    const map={source3:'Fonte trifásica idealizada com impedância interna para permitir cálculo de corrente de falta.',source24:'Fonte de 24 Vcc com resistência interna didática.',breaker3:'Disjuntor motor tripolar. Os polos de potência abrem quando ocorre disparo.',contactor:'A bobina é energizada pela tensão real entre A1 e A2; os contatos principais e auxiliares mudam automaticamente.',overload:'Relé térmico com passagem trifásica e contato 95-96. O modelo acumula efeito térmico conforme corrente.',motor6:'Três enrolamentos independentes. Você decide o fechamento estrela ou triângulo pelos seis bornes.',pbNO:'Contato normalmente aberto e momentâneo.',pbNC:'Contato normalmente fechado e momentâneo.',emergency:'Dois contatos NF mecanicamente associados.',safetyRelay:'Relé didático: exige alimentação, continuidade dos dois canais e reset Y1-Y2 para fechar as saídas.',lamp:'Carga indicadora para circuito de comando.',resistor:'Carga resistiva linear editável.',fuse:'Elemento série que pode abrir em cenário de falha.'};return map[c.type]||'';
  }
  function inspectorAction(c,a){
    if(a==='toggleSource')c.state.enabled=!c.state.enabled;
    if(a==='toggleBreaker'){if(!c.state.tripped)c.state.closed=!c.state.closed;}
    if(a==='resetBreaker'){c.state.tripped=false;c.state.closed=false;state.protectionEvent=null;}
    if(a==='press'){c.state.pressed=true;runSolver(true);setTimeout(()=>{c.state.pressed=false;runSolver(true);saveProject();},450);return;}
    if(a==='toggleEmergency')c.state.pressed=!c.state.pressed;
    if(a==='tripOverload')c.state.tripped=true;
    if(a==='resetOverload'){c.state.tripped=false;c.state.thermal=0;state.protectionEvent=null;}
    if(a==='faultStuck')c.state.stuck=!c.state.stuck;
    if(a==='faultCoil')c.state.coilOpen=!c.state.coilOpen;
    if(a==='resetFuse')c.state.blown=false;
    if(a==='rename'){const name=prompt('Identificação do componente:',c.state.label);if(name&&name.trim())c.state.label=name.trim();}
    if(a==='delete'){state.project.wires=state.project.wires.filter(w=>parseTerm(w.a).cid!==c.id&&parseTerm(w.b).cid!==c.id);state.project.components=state.project.components.filter(x=>x.id!==c.id);state.selectedComponent=null;}
    pushHistory();render();
  }

  function formatA(a){return a>=1000?(a/1000).toFixed(2)+' kA':a>=100?a.toFixed(0)+' A':a>=10?a.toFixed(1)+' A':a.toFixed(2)+' A';}
  function escapeHtml(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));}
  function toast(msg){let t=document.getElementById('v7Toast');if(!t){t=document.createElement('div');t.id='v7Toast';t.className='toast';document.body.appendChild(t)}t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(t._to);t._to=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2200);}

  // ---------- Presets ----------
  function newComp(type,id,x,y,label){return {id,type,x,y,state:defaultState(type,label)}}
  function W(id,a,b,color='#1ea7ff'){return {id,a,b,color}}
  function presetDirect(){
    const cs=[newComp('source3','G1',40,80,'REDE 3~'),newComp('breaker3','Q1',270,60,'Q1'),newComp('contactor','K1',520,50,'K1'),newComp('overload','F1',780,60,'F1'),newComp('motor6','M1',1060,45,'M1'),newComp('source24','PS1',60,360,'PS1'),newComp('pbNC','S0',300,370,'STOP'),newComp('pbNO','S1',515,370,'START')];
    const w=[];let n=1,add=(a,b,c)=>w.push(W('W'+n++,a,b,c));
    [['L1','1L1'],['L2','3L2'],['L3','5L3']].forEach(([a,b])=>add('G1.'+a,'Q1.'+b));[['2T1','L1'],['4T2','L2'],['6T3','L3']].forEach(([a,b])=>add('Q1.'+a,'K1.'+b));[['T1','1L1'],['T2','3L2'],['T3','5L3']].forEach(([a,b])=>add('K1.'+a,'F1.'+b));[['2T1','U1'],['4T2','V1'],['6T3','W1']].forEach(([a,b])=>add('F1.'+a,'M1.'+b));
    // delta bridges
    add('M1.U1','M1.W2','#f0b241');add('M1.V1','M1.U2','#f0b241');add('M1.W1','M1.V2','#f0b241');
    add('PS1.P24','S0.11','#58e6b0');add('S0.12','F1.95','#58e6b0');add('F1.96','S1.13','#58e6b0');add('S1.14','K1.A1','#58e6b0');add('K1.A2','PS1.0V','#4f5963');add('F1.96','K1.13','#58e6b0');add('K1.14','K1.A1','#58e6b0');
    return {components:cs,wires:w,nextId:100};
  }
  function presetMotor(mode){const cs=[newComp('source3','G1',80,120,'REDE 3~'),newComp('breaker3','Q1',360,105,'Q1'),newComp('motor6','M1',720,90,'M1')],w=[];let n=1,add=(a,b,c)=>w.push(W('W'+n++,a,b,c));[['L1','1L1'],['L2','3L2'],['L3','5L3']].forEach(([a,b])=>add('G1.'+a,'Q1.'+b));[['2T1','U1'],['4T2','V1'],['6T3','W1']].forEach(([a,b])=>add('Q1.'+a,'M1.'+b));if(mode==='star'){add('M1.U2','M1.V2','#f0b241');add('M1.V2','M1.W2','#f0b241');}else{add('M1.U1','M1.W2','#f0b241');add('M1.V1','M1.U2','#f0b241');add('M1.W1','M1.V2','#f0b241');}return {components:cs,wires:w,nextId:50};}
  function presetSafety(){
    const p=presetDirect();p.components.push(newComp('safetyRelay','SR1',280,610,'SR1'),newComp('emergency','E0',40,630,'EMERGÊNCIA'),newComp('pbNO','R0',560,650,'RESET'));
    // remove direct PS to STOP and insert safe relay output
    p.wires=p.wires.filter(w=>!(w.a==='PS1.P24'&&w.b==='S0.11'));
    let n=200,add=(a,b,c='#58e6b0')=>p.wires.push(W('W'+n++,a,b,c));
    add('PS1.P24','SR1.A1');add('SR1.A2','PS1.0V','#4f5963');add('SR1.S11','E0.11');add('E0.12','SR1.S12');add('SR1.S21','E0.21');add('E0.22','SR1.S22');add('SR1.Y1','R0.13');add('R0.14','SR1.Y2');add('PS1.P24','SR1.13');add('SR1.14','S0.11');p.nextId=300;return p;
  }
  function presetReverse(){
    const cs=[newComp('source3','G1',30,80,'REDE 3~'),newComp('breaker3','Q1',235,65,'Q1'),newComp('contactor','K1',480,25,'K1 HORÁRIO'),newComp('contactor','K2',480,250,'K2 REVERSÃO'),newComp('overload','F1',770,105,'F1'),newComp('motor6','M1',1050,80,'M1'),newComp('source24','PS1',40,500,'PS1'),newComp('pbNC','S0',260,515,'STOP'),newComp('pbNO','S1',480,500,'HORÁRIO'),newComp('pbNO','S2',480,650,'REVERSÃO')];
    const w=[];let n=1,add=(a,b,c)=>w.push(W('W'+n++,a,b,c));[['L1','1L1'],['L2','3L2'],['L3','5L3']].forEach(([a,b])=>add('G1.'+a,'Q1.'+b));
    // feed both contactors
    [['2T1','L1'],['4T2','L2'],['6T3','L3']].forEach(([a,b])=>{add('Q1.'+a,'K1.'+b);add('Q1.'+a,'K2.'+b)});
    add('K1.T1','F1.1L1');add('K1.T2','F1.3L2');add('K1.T3','F1.5L3');add('K2.T1','F1.3L2','#d38bff');add('K2.T2','F1.1L1','#d38bff');add('K2.T3','F1.5L3','#d38bff');[['2T1','U1'],['4T2','V1'],['6T3','W1']].forEach(([a,b])=>add('F1.'+a,'M1.'+b));add('M1.U1','M1.W2','#f0b241');add('M1.V1','M1.U2','#f0b241');add('M1.W1','M1.V2','#f0b241');
    add('PS1.P24','S0.11','#58e6b0');add('S0.12','F1.95','#58e6b0');
    // K1 rung through K2 NC
    add('F1.96','S1.13','#58e6b0');add('S1.14','K2.21','#58e6b0');add('K2.22','K1.A1','#58e6b0');add('K1.A2','PS1.0V','#4f5963');add('F1.96','K1.13','#58e6b0');add('K1.14','K2.21','#58e6b0');
    // K2 rung through K1 NC
    add('F1.96','S2.13','#58e6b0');add('S2.14','K1.21','#58e6b0');add('K1.22','K2.A1','#58e6b0');add('K2.A2','PS1.0V','#4f5963');add('F1.96','K2.13','#58e6b0');add('K2.14','K1.21','#58e6b0');return {components:cs,wires:w,nextId:200};
  }
  function loadPreset(name){
    if(name==='blank')state.project={components:[],wires:[],nextId:1};else if(name==='direct')state.project=presetDirect();else if(name==='safety')state.project=presetSafety();else if(name==='star')state.project=presetMotor('star');else if(name==='delta')state.project=presetMotor('delta');else if(name==='reverse')state.project=presetReverse();state.selectedComponent=null;state.selectedWire=null;state.meter.red=state.meter.black=null;state.history=[];pushHistory();render();toast('Preset carregado.');
  }

  // ---------- Faults ----------
  function injectFault(){
    const candidates=[];
    for(const c of state.project.components){if(c.type==='contactor')candidates.push(()=>{c.state.coilOpen=true;return `${c.state.label}: bobina aberta`;},()=>{c.state.stuck=true;return `${c.state.label}: contato principal colado`;});if(c.type==='overload')candidates.push(()=>{c.state.tripped=true;return `${c.state.label}: relé térmico desarmado`;});if(c.type==='source3')candidates.push(()=>{c.state.enabled=false;return `${c.state.label}: fonte trifásica desligada`;});if(c.type==='fuse')candidates.push(()=>{c.state.blown=true;return `${c.state.label}: fusível aberto`;});}
    if(state.project.wires.length)candidates.push(()=>{const w=state.project.wires[Math.floor(Math.random()*state.project.wires.length)];state.project.wires=state.project.wires.filter(x=>x!==w);return `Fio rompido entre ${labelTerm(w.a)} e ${labelTerm(w.b)}`;});
    if(!candidates.length){toast('Adicione componentes antes de injetar falha.');return;}
    const msg=candidates[Math.floor(Math.random()*candidates.length)]();state.faultScenario=msg;pushHistory();render();toast('Falha oculta injetada. Use o instrumento para diagnosticar.');
  }

  // ---------- History / persistence ----------
  function snapshot(){return JSON.stringify(state.project)}
  function pushHistory(){const s=snapshot();if(state.history[state.history.length-1]!==s)state.history.push(s);if(state.history.length>30)state.history.shift();saveProject();}
  function undo(){if(state.history.length<2)return toast('Nada para desfazer.');state.history.pop();state.project=JSON.parse(state.history[state.history.length-1]);state.selectedComponent=state.selectedWire=null;render();}
  function saveProject(){try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE,snapshot())}catch{}}
  function restoreProject(){try{const s=localStorage.getItem(STORAGE);if(s){const p=JSON.parse(s);if(p&&Array.isArray(p.components)&&Array.isArray(p.wires)){state.project=p;return true}}}catch{}return false;}
  function exportProject(){const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify({version:7,project:state.project},null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='comandos-eletricos-v7-projeto.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}
  async function importProject(file){try{const raw=JSON.parse(await file.text()),p=raw.project||raw;if(!p||!Array.isArray(p.components)||!Array.isArray(p.wires))throw new Error('Formato inválido');state.project=p;state.selectedComponent=state.selectedWire=null;state.history=[];pushHistory();render();toast('Projeto importado.');}catch(e){toast('Falha ao importar: '+e.message)}}

  // ---------- Events / render ----------
  function render(){renderComponents();drawWires();runSolver(true);saveProject();}
  function bind(){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-v7-tool]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>setTool(b.dataset.v7Tool)));
    $('v7WireColor').addEventListener('input',e=>state.wireColor=e.target.value);
    $('v7LoadPreset').addEventListener('click',()=>loadPreset($('v7Preset').value));$('v7Undo').addEventListener('click',undo);
    $('v7ClearWires').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!state.project.wires.length)return;state.project.wires=[];pushHistory();render();});
    $('v7Export').addEventListener('click',exportProject);$('v7Import').addEventListener('click',()=>$('v7ImportFile').click());$('v7ImportFile').addEventListener('change',e=>{const f=e.target.files?.[0];if(f)importProject(f);e.target.value='';});
    $('v7Run').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.running=e.target.checked;runSolver(true)});$('v7Step').addEventListener('click',()=>runSolver(true));$('v7InjectFault').addEventListener('click',injectFault);
    $('v7MeterMode').addEventListener('change',e=>{state.meter.mode=e.target.value;renderMeter();});$('v7ProbeRed').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.meter.activeProbe='red';renderMeter()});$('v7ProbeBlack').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.meter.activeProbe='black';renderMeter()});
    root.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===root||e.target.classList.contains('v7-board-grid')){state.selectedComponent=state.selectedWire=null;renderInspector();renderComponents();drawWires();}});
    document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!document.getElementById('view-solver')?.classList.contains('active'))return;if((e.key==='Delete'||e.key==='Backspace')&&!['INPUT','SELECT','TEXTAREA'].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName)){if(state.selectedWire){state.project.wires=state.project.wires.filter(w=>w.id!==state.selectedWire);state.selectedWire=null;pushHistory();render();}else if(state.selectedComponent){const c=findComp(state.selectedComponent);if(c)inspectorAction(c,'delete');}}});
    window.addEventListener('resize',()=>requestAnimationFrame(drawWires));root.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{clearWirePreview();});
  }

  async function initMath(){
    try{state.math=await import('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjs@14.8.1/+esm');state.mathReady=true;}catch(e){console.info('V7: math.js indisponível; usando solver complexo interno.',e);}
  }
  async function init(){
    renderPalette();bind();await initMath();if(!restoreProject())state.project=presetDirect();pushHistory();render();state.thermalTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(state.running)runSolver(false)},300);
  }
  init();
  return {state,runSolver,loadPreset};
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
